assessment_summary: I reviewed the guide and installation summary, then inspected the running environment and exercised the documented access points. Docker Compose stack confirmed running with all five containers up. API/admin at :3001 responds (302->200) and its authenticated JSON:API endpoints (/api/v1/clubs, /members, /users) return HTTP 200 with real seeded JSON:API data using the generated bearer token. Swagger UI at :3002 loads (HTTP 200) and is wired to the OpenAPI spec at :3001/v1_openapi.json which serves HTTP 200. The Next.js dev frontend at :3000 serves its login page and I completed a real end-to-end credentials login through /api/auth/callback/credentials; the resulting session resolved to seeded user Jane Doe, the authenticated /en/admin/users page returned 200, and unauthenticated admin access correctly redirected (307). The public seeded apply page rendered. The dockerized frontend at :3003 also served. The MariaDB database is seeded (28 tables, expected users and clubs). The backend PHPUnit suite ran with 83 passed / 323 assertions. Build artifacts (Filament assets, Vite build, Next .next) are present and tool versions match the stack. The only guide-referenced component absent is the Cypress e2e project, but the repository itself explicitly documents its absence, so it is not a defect of this installation. No installation/migration/build/repair actions were performed during validation. The two modified tracked files were reviewable parts of the installation attempt and the resulting stack operates correctly, so the evidence supports a complete, operational installation.
